title: Crisis leadership
learning_outcomes: Explain crisis roles in the context of crisis leadership.
Compare and distinguish safety and information in the context of crisis leadership.
Apply escalation in the context of crisis leadership.
Evaluate and justify decisions about after-action review in the context of crisis leadership.

lessons.title: Crisis roles
lessons.outcome: Explain crisis roles in the context of crisis leadership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving crisis roles; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to tabletop crisis exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain crisis roles from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of crisis roles; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Safety and information
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish safety and information in the context of crisis leadership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving safety and information; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to tabletop crisis exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain safety and information from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of safety and information; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Escalation
lessons.outcome: Apply escalation in the context of crisis leadership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving escalation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to tabletop crisis exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain escalation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: After-action review
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about after-action review in the context of crisis leadership.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving after-action review; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to tabletop crisis exercise.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain after-action review from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of after-action review; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of crisis roles; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of safety and information; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of after-action review; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
